tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Search Schematik's public electronics parts catalogue (boards, sensors, displays, modules) by name, brand, part number or use. Returns a JSON list of parts, best matches first; pass a result's slug to get_part for its pinout and price.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. a part name, brand, part number or use such as 'BME280' or 'oled display'. Parts matching any word are returned, best matches first.

limit.description: How many parts to return at most. Fewer come back when fewer parts match.

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: One part from the catalogue by slug, as JSON: name, brand, part number, description, category, an available vendor price (lowest offer in one currency, USD when available, e.g. 'from 4.5 USD'), pinout and a link to its Schematik page. Brand, part number, description, price and pinout can be null when unavailable.

slug.description: The part's slug as returned by search_parts, e.g. 'bme280-i2c-sensor'.

tools.name: search_build_guides
tools.description: Search published Schematik build guides: complete projects with parts, wiring and firmware. Leave query empty to list featured guides first. Returns a JSON list of guides with a link and a remixUrl; pass a result's slug to get_build_guide for the full guide.

query.description: What the project should do or use, matched against guide titles, descriptions and boards, e.g. 'weather station'. Leave empty to browse guides, featured ones first.

board.description: Only return guides for this board. Omit for all boards.

limit.description: How many guides to return at most. Fewer come back when fewer guides match.

tools.name: get_build_guide
tools.description: A published build guide by slug as markdown: parts, assembly steps, connections and firmware.

slug.description: The guide's slug as returned by search_build_guides, e.g. 'build-a-co2-room-monitor'.
